criteria.quote: Make Wigglytuff Angry, and It Becomes 20 Times Bigger
criteria.revision: Replace the title with: "When Wigglytuff Gets Angry, It Starts Inflating—But How Far Can It Go?" Hold the 20-times detail for the later reveal.

criteria.quote: Its soft, rubbery body reacts when anger takes over.
criteria.revision: Make the detail more distinctly Wigglytuff by connecting its rubbery body to the documented behavior: "Its body is soft and rubbery—and when angered, it sucks in air and inflates to an enormous size."

criteria.quote: How does anger turn a soft body into a giant threat?
criteria.revision: Use the research-supported open question: "When Wigglytuff gets angry, how far can its elastic body expand—and what is that size meant to do?"

criteria.quote: Angry Wigglytuff can become 20 times bigger. / At the biggest point, Wigglytuff can be 20 times larger. / That enormous size intimidates opponents, turning anger into a threat.
criteria.revision: Remove the early size reveal and repeated 20-times line. Build in stages: anger triggers inhalation, inhalation causes steady inflation, the body can expand seemingly without end, and only then reveal that Wigglytuff can sometimes grow 20 times larger to intimidate opponents.

criteria.quote: At the biggest point, Wigglytuff can be 20 times larger.
criteria.revision: Delay this reveal until after the audience hears that Wigglytuff can inflate "seemingly without end," then follow with: "And sometimes, that expansion reaches 20 times its original size."

criteria.quote: ANGER MAKES IT HUGE / TWENTY TIMES LARGER / THE SIZE IS A WARNING
criteria.revision: Give each scene a distinct fact or turn instead of repeating size: introduce the soft, rubbery body; show the deep inhalation; describe the steady inflation; reveal the 20-times detail; then explain that the enormous size intimidates opponents.

criteria.quote: That enormous size intimidates opponents, turning anger into a threat.
criteria.revision: End by resolving the contrast with a stronger synthesis: "The same elastic body known for its luxurious fur can expand seemingly without end—and when Wigglytuff is angry, that enormous size is meant to intimidate opponents."

criteria.quote: Is Wigglytuff cute, or an intimidating balloon?
criteria.revision: Replace the false either-or with a genuine evidence-based split: "Which detail defines Wigglytuff more: fur so pleasant people cannot stop touching it, or inflation used to intimidate opponents?"
